lines.speaker: The Hearth
lines.text: The room is yours now. Every road begins with a conversation.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: {name}. You came from {nation} before, carrying the same argument and pretending not to watch every exit.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: We have never met. Yet you know the road that brought me here—and the question I meant to ask.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: I remember what the last world taught us. You are free to become someone different in this one.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Then tell me what I failed to see, Keeper. I will decide what to do with the warning.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: I came to this crossroads from {nation}. Before that, I worked as {occupation} in {origin}.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: {motivation}

lines.speaker: The Hearth
lines.text: First impressions settle quickly. {personality}

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: What I ask from the people beside me is simple: {preference}. The rest can be learned on the road.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: You asked why I chose this life. The short answer is still true: {motivation}

lines.speaker: The Hearth
lines.text: {biography}

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: That history follows me, but it does not command me. I would rather decide what comes next among people who understand the cost.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: If we travel together, remember this much about me: {preference}. Small promises reveal what grand ones are worth.

lines.speaker: Ulric
lines.text: Helvetica teaches that a seal is public law, not a trophy. I expected a Nordian war camp. Instead I found a Keeper recording failures as carefully as victories.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: The Hearth serves people from every road. Its ledger does not grant any nation ownership of the prisons.

lines.speaker: Ulric
lines.text: Good. Then let me sign it. Civic duty performed from a safe gallery is only commentary.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: The refugees call the Farmstead cursed. The Verdant Concord calls it wounded. Your victories will mean little if the soil keeps burning afterward.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Then show us how suppression differs from healing.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I will. But I will not pretend every prison deserves repair merely because a god designed it.

lines.speaker: Tamsin
lines.text: In the Veiled Isles, a wrong name can bind a spirit more cruelly than iron. Your Crypt records use three names for the same guardian and call all three monsters.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: You think the official account was altered.

lines.speaker: Tamsin
lines.text: I think official accounts are tools. Bring me below, and I will show you whose hand used this one.

lines.speaker: Nessa
lines.text: The Sun-Crowned Dominion agrees Balor is dangerous. It does not agree that an ancient sentence is eternally lawful simply because the judges were gods.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Every nation arrives with a claim.

lines.speaker: Nessa
lines.text: I arrived with an amendment—and the suspicion that the Foundry contains the machinery that made such amendments possible.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: The Hearth feels different from {origin}. I spent enough years as {occupation} to notice what a safe room asks of the people inside it.

lines.speaker: The Hearth
lines.text: {biography}

lines.speaker: The Hearth
lines.text: {name} has become a familiar presence. {personality}

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: I am still the person who first signed the ledger. The difference is that my choices belong to this company now, too.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: When the next expedition is over, I hope there is time for {preference}. That is the future I am trying to return to.

lines.speaker: Merchant
lines.text: The shelves are stocked. Ask what you need.
